pages.text: SYN Daily Ledger analyst note on Kilele Telecom (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 56.34 for KIL8. The note cites steady demand in the telecom sector and cost control at Kilele Telecom (SYN). Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data.
